fixOne: Change that week’s time, or cancel {{what}}
fixMany: Change those weeks’ times, or cancel {{what}}
thenTapPublish: . Then tap Publish on the first week and choose This and following weeks.
moveDayOnlyThisWeek: To move the day, change only this week.
checkAndSave: Check your connection and save again.
savedSeriesDrafts: Saved {{count}} events as drafts. Tap Publish when they’re ready.
savedDraft: Saved as a draft. Tap Publish when it’s ready.
saveFailed: Couldn't save the event. Check your connection and try again; your details are still here.
startedLocked: This event has started, so it can't be changed. Use its register or match log instead.
savedNotPublished_one: Saved as a draft, not published. {{why}}
tapPublishAgain: Tap Publish on the event to try again.
couldntCancel: Couldn't cancel the event. Check your connection and try again.
cancelledButDrafts: Cancelled {{count}} published events, but couldn't remove the unpublished drafts after them. Delete them from the schedule.
cancelledMany: {{count}} events cancelled. They stay on the schedule as Cancelled.
cancelledOne: Event cancelled. It stays on the schedule as Cancelled.
noneDraftsWentOut: None of the {{count}} drafts went out: {{weeks}} {{fix}}
couldntPublishCheck: Couldn't publish "{{title}}". Check your connection and try again.
couldntDeleteCheck: Couldn't delete "{{title}}". Check your connection and try again.
addedFixtures_one: Added {{count}} fixture as drafts. Publish each when it's ready.
addedFixtures_other: Added {{count}} fixtures as drafts. Publish each when it's ready.
nothingPlannedTap: Nothing planned. Tap + to schedule an event.
clashLine: Clashes with {{title}}, {{start}}–{{end}}. Change the time to publish it.
staysCancelled: It stays on everyone's schedule, marked Cancelled.
fixturesArrive: Fixtures arrive as drafts. Families see each one once you publish it.
registerHelp: Tap anyone who didn't come. Saving makes this the completed session; saving again updates it.
seriesPublishHelp: This week is part of a weekly series. Families see what you publish.
seriesDeleteHelp: This week is part of a weekly series. Only drafts are deleted; published weeks stay.
noneEventsWentOut: None of the {{count}} events went out. They’re saved as drafts only you can see.
